title: Is Being Fat a Choice? Bodybuilder Reacts
summary: NH's first react video, on the Jubilee-style debate between fit men (including PED users like Greg Doucette and a Fresh and Fit host) and overweight men. He argues obesity is largely a responsibility issue but adds nuance: shame and body positivity both cut two ways, PED users criticizing fat people are hypocrites, and good fitness educators reach people unlike themselves through empathy rather than insults.
claims: Overeating to obesity also wastes food resources, yet fat people are never targeted by waste-shaming the way showers or flights are
Being fat lowers your value on the dating market but not your worth as a human being
Ex-fat people are often the most aggressively fatphobic because they know how much it sucks
PED users like Greg Doucette who condemn fat people for taking decades off their lives are hypocrites, since heavy PED use does the same
Stating your superiority outright is arrogant; people respond to trauma differently and a teacher must deal with people who are not hardened like him
Western obesity is a product of privilege: mechanization removed physical work and abundant hyperpalatable food made getting fat easy
Societies that shame tend to produce excellence but worse mental health; he leans toward excellence but sees a balance to strike
He bulked to 240 lb and cut back to 190 lb easily because the gain was deliberate, not an ingrained habit; habitual obesity is much harder to reverse
For most bodybuilders gaining weight is the hard part; losing it just means stop overeating and do more cardio
Taking PEDs at a pro bodybuilder level makes you a drug addict, homeless or not
The healthy-food-is-expensive argument is an excuse: kale, quinoa, spinach, brown rice, chicken and broccoli are cheaper than processed junk
He once lived on $690 a month in the US and still ate healthy and got jacked
The enhanced bodybuilders on the panel were vastly bigger than the natural-looking fit guy
If you pass judgment on others you must accept being judged yourself; demanding immunity is slave morality
Body positivity is good when it encourages fat people to go to the gym, and bad when it attacks people who lose weight out of jealousy
Body positivity disempowers by removing personal responsibility and agency, and poisons the well for the next generation
The fitness community is plagued by body dysmorphia because it is never satisfied; accept what you cannot change and work on what you can
You can love your body and still want more; using self-hatred as fuel works at first and then destroys you, while love and acceptance kept him going
Obesity is most rampant in individualistic countries; collectivist cultures (Asia, Latin America) openly comment on weight because you are seen as part of the group
Fat people in public normalize letting yourself go, just as PED users promote drug use simply by being visible
PEDs and overeating are hard to quit because they feel good in the moment; you must address the pleasure before the consequences
The harsh inner voice that motivates you will turn most people off; empathy is a teaching tool and the majority respond better to positive reinforcement
He tries to make anti-PED content from empathy and explanation rather than insults
A good fitness educator is one who reaches people unlike himself; attracting only clones means you are just a mirror
Telling beginners to do their own research is Russian roulette because the algorithm mostly feeds them steroid users and teenage influencers
The masochistic approach to lifting must die; if you hate the gym you will not keep going, it should feel like a kid in a toy store
Pure willpower-based fitness ideology creates one hero and breaks nine others, which is a net negative
Shame pushed him to build his body, but not all shame is equal: parents who constantly shame their kids are usually projecting their own mediocrity
A fit-based dictatorship that sends fat people to camps is dangerous because power always shifts
Fat kids are the result of their parents' habits, which carry into adulthood; if you were raised on balanced meals your ease at staying lean partly comes from that
Willpower is not constant; it fluctuates with mood and hormones, and anyone claiming otherwise is hiding vulnerability
By bodybuilding standards he is fat when flat, but normal people would see a six-pack; bodybuilding and real-world standards differ
Women value many traits (humor, charisma, kindness, status); men mostly value physique, so manosphere gurus project
You do not have to be a bodybuilder: if you are healthy and happy with a dad bod, live your life
